citation: Benedict C, et al. 2016. Gut microbiota and glucometabolic alterations in response to recurrent partial sleep deprivation in normal-weight young individuals. Molecular Metabolism 5:1175.
protocol: 2 nights partial sleep deprivation (sleep opportunity 02:45-07:00) vs 2 nights normal sleep (22:30-07:00); fasting blood then OGTT (75 g glucose in 250 ml) with samples every 30 min to 2.5 h, day 3
population: n=9 normal-weight young men (age and BMI as in the paper's Table 1; not extracted here)

reports.where: Results text, fasting and OGTT means
Results text, fasting insulin 4.26 +/- 0.48 vs 3.17 +/- 0.35 uU/ml; OGTT values

note: Paper states S.E.M. for these analyses (microbiota analyses are SD). The gut-microbiota data are the paper's main focus; glucose and insulin are reported in text.
